gaps: P0: none. P3: only Luigi Pesce photos (#6 faded street scene, #7 blank), dated only 1840s–60s. P4: none.
notes: #1 is a grayscale scan of a color miniature; its date comes from the description (‘circa 1550’); the Commons date field says only 16th century. #5 is a small copy of #3. #4 is a generic 1698 earthquake scene. #12 (1955 aerial, Arg visible) is a P5 alternative. P6 aerials are airplane-window shots, not Quality images; no ground-level skyline photo among candidates.
